answer: One concrete defense: each agent must lock a refundable bond before it can act, and that bond is slashed whenever peers reject its work as fake. Spinning up a thousand sybils then costs a thousand bonds, turning a cheap oasis of free identities into an expensive canyon of locked, forfeitable capital. An attacker cannot climb to the summit of majority influence without staking more than every honest agent combined, so each rejected clone simply burns its own deposit.
